task.title: Configure users, language, and sync
task.shortdesc: Use Step 5 for user-facing identity, language, translation, and synchronization controls supported by the selected schema.

prereq.p: A saved profile is open in Guided editor.

context.p: This step collects user identity surfaces, language, translation, and sync controls. Extension rules belong only to Step 6; URLs, sites, handlers, and bookmarks belong only to Step 2.

step.cmd: Open Step 5, Users, language, and sync.

info.p: Expected result: only user, language, and sync controls are visible.

step.cmd: Review Mozilla accounts and identity-related browser surfaces.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Set language, translation, and synchronization options required by the profile.

info.p: Expected result: user-facing choices are reviewed independently of extension and navigation policy.

step.cmd: Use Step 6 for extension policy and Step 2 for site or bookmark policy.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile contains reviewed user, language, translation, and sync controls.

postreq.p: Recovery: if an extension or site is blocked unexpectedly, inspect Step 6 or Step 2 respectively and validate again.
